pages.text: Look in plains village vineyards or check novice farmers for fruit. Use a grape on a plain lattice without sneaking. The grape stays in your hand, so one can start a row.

pages.title: Keep the Vines
pages.text: Harvest ripe lattice with shears. Eat the grapes for food or put eight in the $(l:psychedelicraft:preparations/brewing_examples)mash tub$(/l) to start a wine batch.
